features.title: Two bodies, one team
features.text: Share a life force with an eidolon while combining its martial abilities with your spellcasting. Eidolon choice determines your tradition and many of your options.

features.title: Act Together
features.text: Coordinate both bodies to gain an additional single action once per round. You share hit points and attack penalties, so protecting both positions and planning actions are essential.
